title: Deploy read retries and recovery
current: Driver preparation captures DeploymentControlPlaneError as a named refusal in raw and progress captures. Pinning and retry guards request only immutable row fields. Ordinary full run reads omit member closure; --include-member-closure requests that expensive diagnostic explicitly. Read-only deploy calls retry read_deadline_exceeded, https_transport_failed, control_plane_connection_lost and the self-deploy door handler_exception on one bounded schedule totaling 62 seconds. Each retry names its code. Exhaustion distinguishes deadlines from unavailable connectivity and names yoke watch deploy -- RUN; QA fingerprint exhaustion preserves that hint in DeploymentOutcomeUnknown. Writes retain their existing behavior.
verification: Disposable settling-run fixture with 24 members and 192 requirements and watcher refusal tests cover the source behavior; merged-main recovery of a blocked production run remains operator proof. Read retry and QA fingerprint source fixtures cover recovery, exhaustion and unchanged write retry boundaries.
